analyst.summary: Tata Chemicals is a large, well-established soda ash and specialty chemicals producer currently caught in a multi-year industry downturn, with revenue and profit both under real pressure. A fresh setback has just emerged as well: its Kenyan subsidiary has been ordered to suspend mining and export operations, adding to the near-term challenges. We rate this a Sell given the combination of a cyclical trough and this new operational disruption.
